description: This file provides a PHP class implementation of a Microsoft Access database driver using ODBC, including methods and class definitions specific to accessing Access databases.

classes.name: ADODB_access
classes.description: A class representing the Microsoft Access driver within the ADOdb library, extending the ADODB_odbc class and implementing specific methods for Access databases.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_access
classes.description: A class for handling record sets obtained from Microsoft Access databases, extending the ADORecordSet_odbc class.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Begins a database transaction, but here it is implemented to always return false, indicating unsupported transactions.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Returns a SQL expression that handles NULL values by replacing them with a specified value, tailored for Access SQL syntax.
